About us

A simple space to explore sound, make changes, and hear the difference.

≋

A little curiosity can change everything.

Sonic is a browser-based audio studio for experimenting with recordings and music. Bring a track, choose your effects, compare the result, and keep refining until it feels right.

01

Your device, your audio

Audio processing happens locally in your browser. You can start editing without creating an account.

02

Room to experiment

Combine effects, switch between their settings, and apply new revisions from your original recording.

03

Hear what changed

Compare Original and Result, jump through the waveform, then download the version you want.

Tools for different moods

Shape frequencies with bass, treble and an eight-band equalizer. Explore reverb, 8D movement, stereo width, reverse playback, distortion, tempo and pitch. Or keep things practical with loudness control, panning and trimming.

Built to stay approachable

Sonic focuses on clear controls and a short path from your source audio to a downloadable result. It is an evolving prototype; processing quality and supported formats depend on your browser and the effects you choose.
